notes.title: Small update and important information!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, today we released a small update that allows you to:
-Change the speed of the game (Important: Some users have noticed an error in which the game gave out a very low FPS instead of 60. Therefore, I recommend setting the speed to maximum) For users who have a stable game of 60 FPS, we recommend not to change the speed of the game.
-Also for users who have a too sharp picture added the ability to enable anti-aliasing.

Attention: We will soon start developing FOS on a new engine to avoid many bugs that cause the game to crash all the time.

Thank you for the attention :)

notes.title: Final update!
notes.notes:
Today comes the last final update that adds 10 new endings to the game. Various bugs and bugs were fixed. Also, many errors in the text were corrected thanks to Darnery who worked on our text in the game, in the Russian localization!

notes.title: Patch
notes.notes:
Small bugfix:
Fixed a bug that caused the game to freeze after striking a demon with a sword.
Fixed a bug with a portal in space.
Increased the dialog window time.
Fixed a couple of things where the camera didn't go to the player.
And also now the portal to the imprisoned master, which requires 50 endings, and works without restrictions.
